3605-4808-5131-6558.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

2707-4872-7817.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Paradox Shaper by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

2770-5571-8095--6.description:
Use Donate to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3698-5270-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
3698-5270-7826.description:
Cast Bag End Banquet by paying {6}.
When Bag End Banquet enters, it triggers itself and Grinding Station.
Resolve the Bag End Banquet trigger, creating three Food tokens.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bag End Banquet.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Bag End Banquet from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2265-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3918-4131-7826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Foods.
3918-4131-7826.notes: Once you have extra mana, Basalt Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

2146-2781-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4605-5542-6148-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6148-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6148-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2034-4679-6023-7747.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1636-2416-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Rise and Shine.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-2416-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

2412-2916-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food token.
Activate the Food tapped in step 1 using Crosis's Attendant's ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

5147-7124-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-7124-7278.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Slash as attackers.
Slash triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2757-3525-4028.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3698-6972-7159.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Tracker enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3446-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2511-6754-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2366-5234-5702-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5234-5702-6791.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-7083-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

586-997-5258-5618-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
586-997-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

708-2034-2459-3927.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege.
Repeat.

803-1429-5330-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-5330-5402.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

372-3908-4344.description:
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Spark Double to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement until Spark Double leaves the battlefield.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement returns to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

487-2584.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
487-2584.description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible, if needed, then cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage equal to the creature's power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage equal to the Saproling's power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

1074-2158-3525.notablePrerequisites:
King Macar does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to King Macar.
1074-2158-3525.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating a Gold artifact token.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1806-2060-4204-4772.description:
Activate Varolz by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, regenerating Varolz.
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability by paying {3} and exiling it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
